response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates exceptional technical depth across 19 years of software development with strong experience in developer tools, testing infrastructure, and CI/CD systems, he lacks the documented people management experience that is mandatory for this role. The position requires a minimum of 2 years in people management or team leadership, and his resume contains no evidence of direct team management, hiring, performance reviews, or career development responsibilities. Despite titles of 'Senior' and 'Staff' engineer, the resume focuses entirely on individual technical contributions rather than leadership or mentoring of others. He is an outstanding individual contributor but not qualified for a people-management role.
strengths: Extensive developer tools and infrastructure expertise including CI/CD systems, testing frameworks (Trial, Fluent-Asserts), and build automation across multiple platforms
19 years of broad technical experience spanning web, mobile, embedded, and real-time systems with demonstrated ability to ship production code and drive architectural decisions
Proven ability to communicate technical concepts through workshops, talks, and teaching (Selenium course, Web Internals workshop, FOSS4G presentations)
concerns: No documented people management experience—lacks evidence of managing teams, conducting performance reviews, hiring decisions, or career development responsibilities (a mandatory minimum requirement)
No clear technical leadership role evidence despite senior titles; resume emphasizes individual contributions rather than guiding teams, mentoring, or architectural leadership responsibilities
Limited evidence of organizational change leadership or strategic roadmap planning; open source founder role lacks detail on team structure or scope

key_factors.factor: No documented technical leadership or mentorship track record
